lines.text: Decision model and database schema

elements.name: Text 9
elements.text:
Reworked ADR-0005 around three append-only decision streams - CEO Ruling, Report Approval and Distribution Authority - replacing a single mutable approvals row that could be overwritten with no trace of what it previously said (#164).
Implemented the model in the schema: nine tables, a current-decisions view and triggers that make the record append-only in the database rather than by convention in application code (#164).
Validated the schema against a real PostgreSQL 16.2 instance rather than assuming it: a partial unique index cannot be a foreign-key target and a CHECK cannot subquery, so the constraint design had to change (#164).

lines.text: Concurrency and correctness

elements.name: Text 12
elements.text:
Built the decision repository with compare-and-swap concurrency: the caller passes back the revision it read, so two people deciding on the same report at once cannot both land silently (#125).
Found that race with my own test before it shipped. SELECT ... FOR UPDATE serialises writers but does not detect a conflict, so the second writer re-read the head the first had just written and committed over it.
Fixed apply_transition reporting a lost race as an illegal transition, so an operator whose move was overtaken is told that it was stale rather than that it was forbidden (#173, #174).
Replaced the single users.role_id column with a user_roles table so one person can hold more than one role, and reconciled the API integration spec to it (#181).
